title: Erase, Then Write
subtitle: Decoupling erase and write in linear attention

chapters.title: The fixed-state problem
chapters.blurb: Softmax attention hoards every key and value; linear attention compresses history into one fixed matrix — and something must be forgotten.

chapters.title: The delta rule: write only the error
chapters.blurb: One step of online gradient descent, actually run: the naive write plateaus on interference, the delta rule grinds recall error to zero.

chapters.title: Erase, then write
chapters.blurb: The paper's move, computed: one scalar clobbers the wrong memory, and channel-wise erase and write gates land a point no scalar can reach.

chapters.title: Gates and decay
chapters.blurb: Sigmoid gates and softplus decay, per channel: scratch space and archive inside one head, with real retention curves.

chapters.title: Where this line is going
chapters.blurb: The 2026 linear-attention frontier — the delta net lineage, the paper's reported numbers, and the honest caveats.
